title: Savings are verified, not just promised
subtitle: The Savings Assurance method behind every rupee we claim
a11yLabel: How WattZap proves savings: an agreed baseline, measurement and verification against the DISCOM bill, and full transparency with tagged data and audit trails.

columns.heading: Agree the baseline
bullets: The agreed 'before' picture comes first, not after
Built from 12 months of bills and meter data

columns.heading: Measure & verify
bullets: Savings compared bill-to-bill against the DISCOM bill
Named reviewer and customer approver on each saving
Full evidence: bills, service reports, meter traces

columns.heading: Transparent by design
bullets: Savings Wallet shows every calculation in full
Every number tagged: estimated, live or verified
Complete audit trail of approvals and uploads

outcomes: Customers pay from measured savings, not upfront kit
Draft numbers are clearly marked and never final
